text.p: British Airways chief executive Robert Ayling said on Monday that Bill Morris, general secretary of the T&G union had written to BA suggesting peace talks over a dispute with ground staff, one of two strike threats the company faces.

Ayling told a news conference that he welcomed the move and was ready to open discussions straight away. "Talks will happen as far as I'm concerned, and my managers are ready now. I see no reason why we can't have an agreement very quickly.
